title: Rosalind and the Postcards
author: Juniper Voss
blurb: Bram Marchetti, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
